**What version of DragonJars are you running?**

**What platform are you running on (Linux / Windows / MacOS)?**

**Where did you get your data files (Steam / GOG / Other)?**

**Describe the problem.**
The more detail you can provide, the better. Examples include which map and square you were on, whether you were in 
combat or not, which enemies you were facing and how many there were, what spell you tried to cast, etc.

If possible, please list out a series of steps I can use to reproduce the problem.
